name: Orb · SHDR-33
description: A thermal image put through a cheap colour print, wrapped on the ball: rounded-box heat sources drift across the plane as plateaus with exponential skirts, their sum saturates to white where they overlap and is quantized into the nested rectangular contours of a false-colour ramp, then the palette is separated into cyan, magenta and yellow and laid down as three misregistered screens of square dots on grainy paper — violet where cyan crosses magenta, orange where magenta crosses yellow, paper showing through the hot cores (WebGL). Ported from Orbkit shdr-33 (MIT).
